capabilities: expand the active tab group and shrink others to minimum size
toggle between manual and auto-expand arrangement modes
trigger actions from the status bar or command palette
extras: README lists limitations (early stage, occasional need to re-trigger expand, no double-click support because Obsidian maximizes on tab double-click) and a TODO roadmap including ratio-based layouts.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to resize or auto-expand split tab groups, so panes stay evenly sized and the active editor can't get more space.
summary: Tab layout plugin that arranges Obsidian's split tab groups evenly or expands the active group, VSCode-style, via commands or a status-bar icon.
